messages.author: 9347048c9379e9a0
messages.subject: eliminating x-axis ticks but keeping the labels???
parts:
Hi All!

I'm plotting a bar graph and would like to get rid of the tixks on the
x-axis. In a previous thread Hadley suggested to set the breaks to NA:

http://groups.google.com/group/ggplot2/browse_thread/thread/f60879c9b980af9f/0ea252285ba64942?lnk=gst&q=x+axis+ticks#0ea252285ba64942

but this eliminates the labels as well! Any suggestions?


dat <- data.frame(cat=rep(c('Site1', 'Site2'), each=2), sex=rep(c('F',
'M'), each=1), dv=abs(rnorm(4, mean=10,sd=2)))
none <- theme_blank()
dodge <- position_dodge(width=0.9)
qplot(data=dat, x=factor(sex), y = dv)
p <- ggplot(dat, aes(x=factor(cat), y = dv, fill=sex))
p
+geom_bar(stat='identity',position="dodge",size=0.5)+scale_x_discrete(breaks=NA)


Thanks
Shai

messages.subject: Re: eliminating x-axis ticks but keeping the labels???
parts:
last_plot() + +opts(axis.x.ticks = theme_blank())

will get rid of all axis ticks, but I'm not sure how do only eliminate the x-axis ones. 

B

messages.author: 0c39e60ddb38622b
messages.subject: Re: eliminating x-axis ticks but keeping the labels???
parts:
Hi:

This gets rid of the ticks on both the x- and y- axis. I'll let you decide whether or not it's acceptable.

... + opts(axis.ticks = theme_blank())

As far as I can tell from the book documentation, it's not possible to remove the ticks on one axis at present...but perhaps someone will show you that/how it can be done. (I'm aware of ongoing work to separate tasks, so it may well be available in the foreseeable future.) Lattice and base graphics allow this type of separation of tasks, however, if it's that important.

HTH,
Dennis

messages.author: 27405c4b711a1080
messages.subject: Re: eliminating x-axis ticks but keeping the labels???
parts:
You can save it the old fashion way.

png("graph.png") #or whatever device you want to use
p+geom_bar(stat='identity',position="dodge",size=0.5)
grid.gremove(gPath("axis_h", "axis.ticks.segments"), grep=T)
dev.off()
